content: Mibpekilala si Jose te menge Suled Din
Kenè en dutun egketigker ni Jose is gehinawa zin, umbe impeliǥawang din is menge suluǥuen din. Hein wazè en dutun menge etew he zuma ni Jose, mibepekilala sikandin te menge suled din.
Midsineǥew zutun si Jose, ne nezineg haazà te menge Ehiptohanen, ne netudtulan dutun is pemilya te hadì.
Migkaǥi si Jose ziyà te menge suled din te, “Iyan a si Jose! Uuyag pe be is amey ku?” Piru wazà meketavak dutun is menge kakey zin su utew zan netentani.

Ne zutun migkeǥiyan ni Jose is menge suled din te, “Uvey kew kayi te kedì.” Ne hein mid-uvayan dan en, ke sikandin te, “Iyan a sikan is suled niw he si Jose, kes imbelegyè niw ne mid-uwit dini te Ehipto.
Kenè kew meseeng, ne kenè kew mebasul te ingkevelegyà a keniyu kayi, su paaǥi heini te Megbevayà is impehuna a kayi para meluwas kew te mereǥen he ked-ubpà.
Dezuwe en he tuig is ked-aǥi te vitil zini te kenitew ne egkeumanan pa heini te lelima he tuig he wazà egkeraǥun te ebasuk.
Piru impehuna a zini te Megbevayà su ebpengelinteuwan din he kenè kew mebpatey te vitil ne zuen samà kenitew zini te kelibutan.
Umbe, kenè kew iyan mibpuwit kayi kedì, kekenà, iyan is Megbevayà. Midhimu e zin he peresambag te hadì kayi te Ehipto wey ibpezumala te pemilya zin, wey edumala te tivuuk he ginhedian te Ehipto.

Ne ǥuntaan, gaanggaan kew ulì diyà te amey tew ne keǥiya niw kandin he is anak din he si Jose ne midhimu te Megbevayà he iyan ebayàbayà te tivuuk he ginhedian te Ehipto. Ne keǥiyi niw sikandin te ibpeǥaanggaan ku ibpehendini.

Keǥiyi niw sikandin he egkehimu he ebpekeubpà sikandin diyà te inged he Goshen duma te menge anak din wey menge apù din, menge uyaǥen, wey is langun he menge azen din, para uvey zà sikandin kayi te kedì.

Ne emun diyè en sikandin te Goshen, ne ed-elimahan ku sikandin su zuen pa lelima he tuig he vitil he ebpeebuten. Kenè ku egkesuatan he egkeumes sikandin wey is menge pemilya zin ragkes is menge uyaǥen din.”
Ne impelaus ni Jose is menge lalag din te, “Guntaan, wazè en mekeeles keniyu, wey te suled ku he si Benjamin he tutuu iyan he iyan a si Jose is ebpekidlalag keniyu.
Keǥiya niw ziyà te amey ku is mehitenged te ketengdanan ku kayi te Ehipto wey is langun he neehè niw parti kedì, ne ǥègaani niw sikandin ipehendini te kedì.”
Ne zutun migkepkepan din is hazi zin he si Benjamin ne midsineǥawan din, ne midsineǥew zaan si Benjamin is egkepkep daan kandin.
Ne midhezekan ni Jose is langun he menge kakey zin he edsineǥaw sikandin. Ne zutun human mekepekidlalag kandin is menge suled din.
Ne hein netudtul haazà diyà te turuǥan te hadì te Ehipto he nemekeuma is menge suled ni Jose, utew nesuat kes hadì ne nesuat daan is menge upisyal zin.
Migkaǥi haazà is hadì diyà te ki Jose te, “Keǥiyi nu is menge suled nu he iyan ibpeulaula ku kandan is: ‘Kergahi zan is menge asnu zan ne med-ulì dan diyà te Canaan.

Ne dumaha zan is amey niw wey is menge pemilya zan dini te kediey. Ebeǥayan ku sikandan te utew meupiya he tanà dini te ǥinhedian ku he Ehipto. Ibpekaan ku sikandan te utew meupiya zini te ǥinhedian ku.’
Keǥiyi nu sikandan he med-uwit dan te menge kerumata he ebpuun kayi te Ehipto he egkeuntuzan te menge esawa zan wey te menge anak dan wey zan mekahalin dini. Ne uwita zan dini is amey zan.
Kenè dan menuǥuni is menge azen dan he egkengetaǥak dan su is menge meupiya he menge azen kayi te tivuuk he Ehipto ne egkaangken dan.”
Midtuman heini te menge anak ni Jacob. Ne sumalà te suǥù te hadì te Ehipto, impeuwit ni Jose is menge suled din te menge kerumata ne impelulutù din te egkekaan dan te edhipanew.
Mibeǥayan ni Jose te ed-ilisan is kada sevaha kandan; piru is imbeǥey zin ki Benjamin ne lelima he ed-ilisan wey 300 he elad he pelata.

Mibpeuwitan din daan is amey zin te 10 he asnu he migkergahan te menge meupiya he menge pruduktu te Ehipto, wey 10 he asnu he menge vehiyan he migkergahan te veǥas te trigu, supas, wey edlutuen te amey zan te kedhipanew.
Ne hein impeǥenat din is menge suled din, ke sikandin te, “Kenè kew mebpeeg-eǥetà diyà te zalan.”
Ne mid-awè dan diyà te Ehipto ne nekeuma zan diyà te amey zan he si Jacob diyà te Canaan.

Hein nekeuma zan diyà, midtudtulan dan is amey zan te uuyag pa si Jose, ne iyan sikandin ebayàbayà te tivuuk he ǥinhedian te Ehipto. Ne netentanan dutun si Jacob ne wazà mekekaǥi; henduen te kenà dutun ebpeketuu sikandin.

Piru hein midtudtulan dan sikandin te langun he migkaǥi ni Jose ziyà te kandan, wey hein neehè din is menge kerwahi he impeuwit ni Jose he ebpeuntuzan kandin wey mekehalin sikandin diyà te Ehipto, ne nekelikù is hustu he ked-isip-isip din.
Ne migkaǥi si Jacob te, “Nevenaran a human! Uuyag pe bes iyan is anak ku he si Jose! Edhendiyà a te kandin wey ku sikandin maahà te kenè e pa ebpatey!”
